title: User torsional spring-damper with unlimitedRotations: the turns as a data coordinate
author: Claude-JG
description: UserItemCreator.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper refuses unlimitedRotations=True, its default, as the turns need a data coordinate. Decided: a NodeGenericData with the number of turns, updated by the post-Newton function of ObjectConnectorUser, as CObjectConnectorTorsionalSpringDamper does.
releaseNotes: UserItemCreator.CreateTorsionalSpringDamper takes unlimitedRotations: the turns in a data node of the connector, updated by its post-Newton function, as the built-in item; test model symbolicUserTorsionalTurnsTest.
